enp.scope: All source features whose NUT2 competent-authority field includes30(Madrid),41(Castilla y León),42(Castilla-La Mancha), plus official inter-autonomous national parks ES801001(Picos de Europa) and ES802001(Sierra de Guadarrama), coded80 by the source and explicitly documented by MITECO as extending into these regions. Complete official site geometries retained, including the park parts in Asturias/Cantabria and outside the hydrography bbox. This is not all Spanish ENP.
enp.part_deduplication: Source parts sharing SITE_CODE_ and DESIG_ABBR merged as Polygon/MultiPolygon; original source row IDs retained. No polygon union, clipping or smoothing.

geometry_processing: No clipping, smoothing or topological simplification. XY rounded to six decimal degrees (submetre encoding), with nine decimals retained for tiny line segments that would otherwise collapse; source Z omitted from display geometry and preserved in cached official downloads. Separate official DEM provides map relief.
chunking: 0.25 degree cell by feature bbox centre, then batches <=1.5MB or500features; chunk bbox is union of actual complete feature bounds, not the cell extent. Large individual features are never cut to meet byte target.
limitations: Counts are source features/segments and water bodies, not counts of unique rivers.
No walking paths, access permissions, water levels, bathing suitability, species observations or photographs are inferred.
Nameless source objects retain null names; display fallback labels must not be presented as official names.
Source date is not a statement of live environmental conditions.

regional_intersection.method: Derived intersection with official IGN autonomous-community polygons, using GEOS/Shapely intersects on complete feature geometry. Not centroid assignment, containment, source administrative-authority code or bbox-only membership.
regional_intersection.semantics: A bit is set when any part of the feature intersects or touches that region. Multiple bits may be set.0 means no intersection with the three tested regions; it does not identify another region.
regional_intersection.boundary_source: Instituto Geográfico Nacional / CNIG, official administrative boundaries; CC BY4.0 ign.es
regional_intersection.coordinate_model: GEOS planar topological intersection of longitude/latitude geometries in the same CRS84 axis order; no buffer, centroid approximation or added tolerance. Underlying source scale, coordinate encoding and boundary accuracy still apply.

delivery.verification: SHA-256 of every decompressed payload equals the original JSON. Features, properties, coordinate precision and geometry remain unchanged.
delivery.decode: Native browser DecompressionStream; the geographic index stays plain JSON. Only requested geographic chunks are decompressed.
